name: CMSPS Revenue Pulse Advisor
author: CodingMall.com

sections.description:
CMSPS Revenue Pulse Advisor helps WooCommerce store owners review store performance without leaving wp-admin. The plugin collects aggregated WooCommerce metrics for a selected period, sends them for AI analysis, and returns a structured revenue report with observations and recommendations you can review later.

Use this plugin to:
* Run WooCommerce revenue analysis for preset windows or custom date ranges up to 90 days.
* Review AI-generated sales insights for revenue, orders, AOV, refunds, discounts, and trend changes.
* Inspect saved analysis history with status tracking, filters, and detailed result pages.
* View source data snapshots including top products, top categories, KPI summaries, and period comparisons.
* Export analysis results as PDF using your browser print dialog.
* Check your current credit balance from inside wp-admin.
* Buy additional credits through live checkout links.
* Review past credit purchase history for your connected site.
* Automatically provision site credentials on supported live public domains.

The plugin adds a dedicated WooCommerce admin area with:
* Settings page for connection status, site ID, API connectivity, and credits remaining.
* Run Revenue Analysis page for preset or custom reporting windows.
* Revenue Analysis Results page for browsing past reports.
* Revenue Analysis Detail page for full AI output plus supporting source metrics.
* Buy Credits page for purchasing credit packs.
* Credits Purchased page for reviewing successful credit top-ups.

This plugin is designed for WooCommerce merchants who want AI sales insights, WooCommerce revenue trends, and store performance reporting without building custom dashboards or exporting raw data manually.

External services

This plugin uses external services for site activation, credit balance checks, AI revenue analysis, and credit purchases.

Services used:
* CMSPS SaaS: https://codingmall.com
* FastSpring checkout: https://fastspring.com

Requests are sent:
* During automatic site activation or reconnection
* When you run a revenue analysis
* When the plugin loads credit balance, credit history, or live checkout links

Data sent:
* Site/store identifiers needed for activation and authentication
* Aggregated WooCommerce reporting data for the selected analysis period
* site_id in checkout links so purchased credits can be assigned to the correct site

Policies:
* Terms of Use: https://codingmall.com/terms-of-use
* Privacy Policy: https://codingmall.com/privacy-policy
* FastSpring Privacy Policy: https://fastspring.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/cmsps-revenue-pulse-advisor, or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  3. Open Revenue Pulse Advisor > Settings.
  4. Wait for the plugin to generate site credentials automatically on a live public domain.
  5. Confirm the plugin shows a connected status and your available credits.
  6. Open Run Revenue Analysis and choose a preset window or custom date range.
  7. Accept the AI disclaimer and run your first report.
  8. Review saved reports from Revenue Analysis Results.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

What does this plugin analyze?

The plugin analyzes aggregated WooCommerce store data for the selected period, including revenue, order count, average order value, refunds, discounts, top products, top categories, and comparison signals between periods.

What kind of reports does it generate?

It generates AI-assisted WooCommerce revenue analysis reports with observations, trends, and recommendations that you can review later from inside wp-admin.

Can I run reports for custom dates?

Yes. You can choose preset windows or a custom date range up to 90 days.

Can I export WooCommerce analysis results?

Yes. Each saved result includes an export action that opens a print-friendly view you can save as PDF from your browser.

How are credits purchased?

Use the Buy Credits screen inside the plugin.

Can I review previous reports and credit purchases?

Yes. The plugin includes pages for saved revenue analysis results and credit purchase history.

Do I need to enter API credentials manually?

No. The plugin attempts to generate site credentials automatically after activation on a live public domain.

Does it work on localhost or private development domains?

Automatic activation is intended for live public domains. Localhost and private/test environments are not eligible for automatic activation.

Does the plugin store payment details?

No. Payments are handled by FastSpring checkout links.
